333-413-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-413-8207.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Shepherd of the Cosmos trigger, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

628-2018-4771.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability
Repeat

533-3231-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-3231-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2024-7891.description:
Activate Woodland Weavemaster by tapping it, adding an amount of {G/W} equal to its power that can only be spent to activate abilities of Elves or to cast Elf spells.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Woodland Weavemaster and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat, alternating between adding {G} and {W} each loop as needed.
2024-7891.notes: The mana prerequisite can be reduced by up to {2}{G/W} if Woodland Weavemaster starts the combo with greater power. As the combo makes more mana each loop, the excess mana can then be used to increase the power and toughness of other creatures as desired.

2-4659-5554-7824.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5470-5686-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

1718-1796-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Centaur Omenreader.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-1796-6072-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4693-5671.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-4693-5671.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1987-4125-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4125-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Donnie & April and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4125-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

145-2645-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
145-2645-6474.description:
Activate a creature using Serra's Sanctum's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-4050.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-4050.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

4222-5268-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

969-1563-2457-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3168-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3168-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3168-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

826-2608-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2608-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Derevi.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Derevi from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

2157-2598-3013.easyPrerequisites:
You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor's ability this turn.
You control a mana-producing land and/or creature.
2157-2598-3013.description:
Cast Nissa by paying {5}{G}{G}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Nissa spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Nissa spells.
Activate a mana-producing land or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Nissa token.
Activate a Nissa token's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping Romana II, up to one other creature and up to two lands.
Repeat from step 4.

261-440-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
261-440-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1753-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1753-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

428-2770-5096-5362.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2770-5096-5362.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2034-2208-3263-4230.description:
Cast Charming Scoundrel by paying {2}.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Charming Scoundrel, adding {2}.
Charming Scoundrel is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necromancer's Magemark.
The Wicked Role token that was attached to Charming Scoundrel triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1164-2003-2056-4084.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {6} and tapping it, putting two loyalty counters on Saheeli.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Part the Waterveil and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Part the Waterveil being the top most card.
Move to your next turn, drawing Part the Waterveil during your draw step.
Repeat.

1267-1795-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of Medomai and Mistmeadow Vanisher until Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Medomai triggers, exiling Exchange of Words until your end step.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, Medomai and Mistmeadow Vanisher retain their original textboxes.
Deal combat damage using Medomai.
Medomai triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Medomai triggers, returning Exchange of Words to the battlefield from exile.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of Medomai and Mistmeadow Vanisher until Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1393-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {C}{C}.
Aether Channeler dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1545-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
1545-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Trostani and gaining you 3 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
